briefdescription.para: Engine-side free module R^n over a Ring.

detaileddescription.para: Holds the underlying Ring* plus a components vector with the multi-degree of each generator; optionally carries a SchreyerOrder* that pins the per-component tie-breaker data used when the free module participates in a Schreyer resolution. Constructed only through Ring-side factory paths (the constructor is private) so the engine can guarantee the ring / degree pair is consistent before any vectors live in it.
